--[[

--==================================================
-- MAIN GUI
--==================================================

if syn and syn.protect_gui then
    syn.protect_gui(ScreenGui)

    ScreenGui.Parent = gethui()

    btn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 24, 0, 24)

    btn.AutoButtonColor = false

    local btnCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    btnCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

--==================================================

--==================================================

local COLOR_ON = Color3.fromRGB(0, 230, 118)

--==================================================
-- TOGGLE ROW
--==================================================

local function createToggleRow(nameText, order)

    RowFrame.LayoutOrder = order

    local TextLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    TextLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 160, 1, 0)
    TextLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    TextLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    TextLabel.TextSize = 13
    TextLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    TextLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    TextLabel.Text = nameText
    TextLabel.Parent = RowFrame

    local ToggleBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    ToggleBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 50, 0, 24)
    ToggleBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -50, 0.5, -12)
    ToggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = COLOR_OFF
    ToggleBtn.Text = ""
    ToggleBtn.AutoButtonColor = false
    ToggleBtn.Parent = RowFrame

    local ToggleCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    ToggleCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    ToggleCorner.Parent = ToggleBtn

    local Slider = Instance.new("Frame")
    Slider.Size = UDim2.new(0, 18, 0, 18)
    Slider.Position = UDim2.new(0, 3, 0.5, -9)
    Slider.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    Slider.BorderSizePixel = 0
    Slider.Parent = ToggleBtn

    local SliderCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    SliderCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    SliderCorner.Parent = Slider

    return ToggleBtn, Slider
end

--==================================================
-- ACTION BUTTON
--==================================================

local function styleActionButton(btn, text, order)

    btn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 230, 0, 38)
    btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    btn.TextSize = 13
    btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    btn.Text = text
    btn.LayoutOrder = order
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = COLOR_ACTION
    btn.AutoButtonColor = false

    local btnCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    btnCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
    btnCorner.Parent = btn

    local btnStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    btnStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    btnStroke.Transparency = 0.85
    btnStroke.Thickness = 1
    btnStroke.Parent = btn

    btn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()

        if MainFrame.Size == UDim2.new(0, 260, 0, 365) then

            TweenService:Create(
                btn,
                TweenInfo.new(
                    0.2,
                    Enum.EasingStyle.Back,
                    Enum.EasingDirection.Out
                ),
                {
                    Size = UDim2.new(0, 234, 0, 40)
                }
            ):Play()

            TweenService:Create(
                btnStroke,
                TweenInfo.new(0.2),
                {
                    Transparency = 0.5
                }
            ):Play()
        end
    end)

    btn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()

        if MainFrame.Size == UDim2.new(0, 260, 0, 365) then

            TweenService:Create(
                btn,
                TweenInfo.new(
                    0.2,
                    Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,
                    Enum.EasingDirection.Out
                ),
                {
                    Size = UDim2.new(0, 230, 0, 38)
                }
            ):Play()

            TweenService:Create(
                btnStroke,
                TweenInfo.new(0.2),
                {
                    Transparency = 0.85
                }
            ):Play()
        end
    end)

    btn.Parent = Container
end

--==================================================
-- COMPONENTS
--==================================================

local SpinBotBtn, SpinSlider =
    createToggleRow("spinBOT", 1)

local TpAwayBtn =
    Instance.new("TextButton")

styleActionButton(
    TpAwayBtn,
    "tpAWAY",
    2
)

local TpBtn =
    Instance.new("TextButton")

styleActionButton(
    TpBtn,
    "tp",
    3
)

    createToggleRow("angryTP", 4)

local TpUpBtn =
    Instance.new("TextButton")

styleActionButton(
    TpUpBtn,
    "tpUP",
    5
)

-- NEW SPEED TOGGLE
local SpeedBtn, SpeedSlider =
    createToggleRow("speed", 6)

--==================================================
-- STATE
--==================================================

local spinbotOn = false
local angryTpOn = false
local speedOn = false

local spinConnection
local angryTpConnection

local isMinimized = false

-- Speed starts at normal Roblox default
local currentSpeed = 16

--==================================================
-- TOGGLE ANIMATION
--==================================================

local function animateToggle(btn, slider, state)

    local targetPos =
        state
        and UDim2.new(1, -21, 0.5, -9)
        or UDim2.new(0, 3, 0.5, -9)

    local targetColor =
        state
        and COLOR_ON
        or COLOR_OFF

    TweenService:Create(
        slider,
        TweenInfo.new(
            0.2,
            Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,
            Enum.EasingDirection.Out
        ),
        {
            Position = targetPos
        }
    ):Play()

    TweenService:Create(
        btn,
        TweenInfo.new(
            0.2,
            Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,
            Enum.EasingDirection.Out
        ),
        {
            BackgroundColor3 = targetColor
        }
    ):Play()
end

--==================================================
-- CHARACTER HELPERS
--==================================================

local function getCharacter()
    return LocalPlayer.Character
end

local function getHumanoid()

    local character = getCharacter()

    if character then
        return character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    end

    return nil
end

local function applySpeed()

    local humanoid = getHumanoid()

    if humanoid and speedOn then
        humanoid.WalkSpeed = currentSpeed
    end
end

--==================================================
-- TP HELPERS
--==================================================

local function getBehindCFrame(targetPlayer)

    if targetPlayer
        and targetPlayer.Character
        and targetPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then

        local targetRoot =
            targetPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart

        return targetRoot.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, 3)
    end

    return nil
end

local function getRandomPlayer()

    local allPlayers = Players:GetPlayers()
    local available = {}

    for _, p in ipairs(allPlayers) do

        if p ~= LocalPlayer
            and p.Character
            and p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then

            table.insert(available, p)
        end
    end

    if #available > 0 then
        return available[
            math.random(
                1,
                #available
            )
        ]
    end

    return nil
end

--==================================================

CurrentSpeedLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 108)

CurrentSpeedLabel.Text = "Current speed: " .. tostring(currentSpeed)

CurrentSpeedLabel.TextSize = 13
CurrentSpeedLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
CurrentSpeedLabel.ZIndex = 22
CurrentSpeedLabel.Parent = SpeedWindow

--==================================================
-- SPEED BOX INPUT
--==================================================

SpeedBox:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()

    local text = SpeedBox.Text

    -- Allow numbers and decimals only
    local cleaned = text:gsub("[^%d%.%-]", "")

    if cleaned ~= text then
        SpeedBox.Text = cleaned
        return
    end

    local number = tonumber(cleaned)

    if number then

        currentSpeed = number

        CurrentSpeedLabel.Text =
            "Current speed: " .. tostring(currentSpeed)

        applySpeed()
    end
end)

--==================================================
-- OPEN SPEED WINDOW
--==================================================

SpeedBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

    speedOn = not speedOn

    animateToggle(
        SpeedBtn,
        SpeedSlider,
        speedOn
    )

    if speedOn then

        applySpeed()

        SpeedWindow.Visible = true

        SpeedWindow.Size =
            UDim2.new(0, 260, 0, 155)

        TweenService:Create(
            SpeedWindow,
            TweenInfo.new(
                0.25,
                Enum.EasingStyle.Back,
                Enum.EasingDirection.Out
            ),
            {
                Size = UDim2.new(0, 280, 0, 175)
            }
        ):Play()

    else

        local humanoid = getHumanoid()

        if humanoid then
            humanoid.WalkSpeed = 16
        end

        SpeedWindow.Visible = false
    end
end)

--==================================================

SpinBotBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

    spinbotOn = not spinbotOn

    animateToggle(
        SpinBotBtn,
        SpinSlider,
        spinbotOn
    )

    if spinbotOn then

        spinConnection =
            RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()

                local char = LocalPlayer.Character
                local root =
                    char and char:FindFirstChild(
                        "HumanoidRootPart"
                    )

                if root then
                    root.CFrame =
                        root.CFrame *
                        CFrame.Angles(
                            0,
                            math.rad(140),
                            0
                        )
                end
            end)

    else

        if spinConnection then
            spinConnection:Disconnect()
            spinConnection = nil
        end
    end
end)

    local char = LocalPlayer.Character

        char and char:FindFirstChild(
            "HumanoidRootPart"

        root.CFrame =
            root.CFrame +
            Vector3.new(3000000, 0, 0)

--==================================================
-- TP
--==================================================

TpBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    local root =
        char and char:FindFirstChild(
            "HumanoidRootPart"
        )

    if root then

        local target =
            getRandomPlayer()

        if target then

            local targetCFrame =
                getBehindCFrame(target)

            if targetCFrame then
                root.CFrame = targetCFrame
            end
        end
    end
end)

        AngrySlider,
        angryTpOn

            RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()

                local char = LocalPlayer.Character

                    char and char:FindFirstChild(
                        "HumanoidRootPart"

                if root then

                        getRandomPlayer()

                    if target then

        TweenService:Create(

--==================================================
-- DRAGGING
--==================================================

local dragging
local dragInput
local dragStart
local startPos

local function update(input)

    local delta =
        input.Position - dragStart

    TweenService:Create(
        MainFrame,
        TweenInfo.new(
            0.08,
            Enum.EasingStyle.Linear
        ),
        {
            Position = UDim2.new(
                startPos.X.Scale,
                startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
                startPos.Y.Scale,
                startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
            )
        }
    ):Play()
end

MainFrame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)

    if input.UserInputType ==
        Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        or input.UserInputType ==
        Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPos = MainFrame.Position

        input.Changed:Connect(function()

            if input.UserInputState ==
                Enum.UserInputState.End then

                dragging = false
            end
        end)
    end
end)

MainFrame.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)

    if input.UserInputType ==
        Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
        or input.UserInputType ==
        Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

        dragInput = input
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)

    if input == dragInput and dragging then
        update(input)
    end
end)
